notes.title: Update 1.25
notes.content:
Several of the game's major issues have been fixed, including:
[list]
[*] All pixel distortion should now be gone
[*] All sound effects will now be muted when choosing to mute sound effects
[*] Tesla Coils will not travel in the wrong direction if upgrading them causes them to collide with a path or obstacle
[/list]
